KC600 SATA SSD KC600 2.5" and mSATA SSD
Kingston’s KC600 is a full-capacity SSD designed to provide remarkable performance and optimised to provide functional system responsiveness with incredible boot, loading and transfer times. It comes in both 2.5" and mSATA form factors using SATA Rev 3.0 interface with backwards compatibility. The KC600 utilises the latest 3D TLC NAND technology while supporting a full security suite that includes AES 256-bit hardware encryption, TCG Opal 2.0 and eDrive. It features read/write speeds of up to 550/520MB/s1 to efficiently store your data up to 2TB2.
